listing.name: Splatterhouse (2010) — Splatterhouse Recompiled — native Xbox 360 → PC port (0c0de)
listing.summary: The project claims campaign and DLC play from start to finish at 60 FPS. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Splatterhouse (2010) Xbox 360 disc ISO. Title 4E4D07F0; DLC optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run install.bat with your own Splatterhouse ISO to extract it and build the native runtime locally. DLC packages are optional.

warnings: The project claims campaign and DLC play from start to finish at 60 FPS.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
